proposals.evidence: Ordered weight + absence components: DEDR1404 supplies kaṉam heaviness and DEDR2559 supplies illa/illā not existing, including ordinary negative adjectival forms. The survey whole expressions mean light, literally without weight; their source contractions and endings are preserved. DEDR1404 expressly notes influence from Sanskrit ghana on the kaṉa heavy family; that contact qualification is retained, and no unsupported immediate donor is asserted.

proposals.evidence: Ordered ground + gram: DEDR3676 nilam/nela earth/ground and1120 kaṭalai/kaṭala gram. Survey nila-/nela-kaḍala(i) groundnut transparently contains both constituents; its modern groundnut designation is retained as a compound, not conflated with the botanical gram referent of1120.
